command:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${LABEL_SELECTOR:?LABEL_SELECTOR is required}"
pods=$(kubectl get pods -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" -l "$LABEL_SELECTOR" -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
read -r -a targets <<< "$pods"
if [[ ${#targets[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly one primary for $LABEL_SELECTOR; found ${#targets[@]}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
target="${targets[0]}"
echo "Backing up PostgreSQL target $POD_NAMESPACE/$target"
kubectl exec -i -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" "$target" -c "$CONTAINER_NAME" -- bash -s < /scripts/script.sh
echo "Backup command completed for $POD_NAMESPACE/$target"
containers.name: backup

env.name: PATRONI_POSTGRESQL_PARAMETERS
env.value:
wal_level: replica
archive_mode: on
archive_timeout: 60
archive_command: '/wal-g/wal-g wal-push  --config /wal-g-credentials/.walg.env %p'
restore_command: '/wal-g/wal-g wal-fetch --config /wal-g-credentials/.walg.env %f %p'

args:
set -eu
cp wal-g-pg-ubuntu-20.04-amd64 /usr/local/bin/wal-g
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/wal-g
mkdir -p /usr/local/bin/commands
cat > /usr/local/bin/commands/restore_backup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
PGDATA="${1:?data directory required}"
[[ "${2:-false}" == "true" ]] || exit 1
: "${BASE_BACKUP_NAME:?backup name required for restore}"
echo "Fetching selected WAL-G base backup: $BASE_BACKUP_NAME"
exec /wal-g/wal-g backup-fetch "$PGDATA" "$BASE_BACKUP_NAME" --config /wal-g-credentials/.walg.env
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/commands/restore_backup.sh
initContainers.name: wal-g
